correctness.rationale: The k[t]-module centralizer parametrization has n+6 independent coefficients. Squaring gives four exact block identities; valuation of a(t) yields the parity-dependent cutoffs. Even n reduces to a 2-equation complete intersection plus affine component; the complete-intersection regular-sequence and lower-dimensional boundary prove geometric irreducibility. Odd n reduces to three irreducible quadratic/linear components. Direct fiber counting gives q^(h+1)(2q^2-1) and q^(h+2)(3q-2) in all prime powers; characteristic 2 is covered without division by 2. Coordinate and ordinary-matrix exhaustive checkers reproduce 7 and 3 small cases. Finite checks are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The fixed (n,2) two-block nilpotent is the first uniform non-hook small-tail family beyond (n,1); its square-zero commuting fiber is a natural moduli invariant governing commuting two-step differentials. The theorem determines every component, their common intersections, their all-field dimensions, and an exact all-finite-field point count. The parity switches the number of equidimensional components from two to three, a phenomenon not present in the prior hook statement. It applies to infinitely many matrix sizes and every field characteristic; it is not an isolated experiment or normalization consequence.
